The three most important review points: `store/memo.go` holds the definition and `store/driver.go:29-30` puts it in the `Driver` interface, so every backend must match; the three `store/db/*/memo.go` files scan SQL columns into the struct field-by-field (`var memo store.Memo`), so a field change breaks them at the column-mapping level; and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` is the single translation point from the struct to the API `v1pb.Memo`.

That generated file does not reference the `store.Memo` struct itself (its `store.Memo*` matches are proto message names like `memos.store.MemoPayload`), but it is the schema behind the field if your change touches `Payload`.
